title: Titanium Spinal Fixation Rod
alloyReason: Ti-3Al-2.5V (Grade 9) offers higher strength than CP grades with excellent cold formability, weldability, and corrosion resistance. It is ideal for tubing, bicycle components, and aerospace ducting requiring a balance of strength and ductility.
commonFailures: Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86)
Thread damage from improper installation torque exceeding recommended values
Galvanic corrosion at interface with dissimilar metals in electrolyte environments

faq.q: What is a titanium spinal fixation rod?
faq.a: A titanium spinal fixation rod is a precision-machined spine fixation component used in spinal fixation connection rod (grade 9 / beta-ti). Manufactured from Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium spinal fixation rod?
faq.a: Titanium Spinal Fixation Rod is manufactured to ASTM F136 / ISO 5832-3 (Ti-6Al-4V ELI) or ASTM F1295 (Ti-6Al-7Nb) for medical implants. This requires oxygen <0.13%, iron <0.25%, and 100% traceability with MTC per batch.

faq.q: How is titanium spinal fixation rod manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Spinal Fixation Rod is manufactured using VAR melting. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium spinal fixation rod?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.q: What is the lead time for titanium spinal fixation rod?
faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
